## `get_project_analyst`

*Available in [R](#get_project_analyst-r), [Python](#get_project_analyst-python)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function returns the Project Analyst Name. If none exists, it
    will return the value of CIDAtools.analyst option or blank if the option
    is not set.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    get_project_analyst()

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>
    *No arguments*
    <h4>Returns</h4>

    A character string with the analyst name


=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    None
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    get_project_analyst(
        project
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project` (`CIDAProject`) - None

    <h4>Returns `None | str | list[str]`</h4>

    *No return value*
